policy.retained: Raw measurements, bundled launch/configuration/provenance/validation records, profile summaries, matched comparisons, source patches, final test logs, reproduction tools, and cleanup/restoration audits.
policy.local_only: Full telemetry, runtime/build/download logs, duplicate metadata and monitor scripts, one-off orchestration, model configuration dumps, and excluded-run runtime files. Files remain locally; none were deleted.
policy.telemetry_audit: record.json retains the original per-rank audit and hashes of local telemetry. Raw telemetry is not part of the Git evidence set.
